marketDirection.headline: Indian market is advancing today.

reasons.text: Nifty 50 closed -0.61% at 25,144, above its 20-DMA, above the 50-DMA (rising), above the 200-DMA.
The index is up 0.5% over the last five sessions — uptrend structure intact.
Market breadth is mixed — 36.3% of scanned NSE stocks advancing, 51.1% above their 50-DMA.
Institutional cash absorption indicates large-cap base support, favoring swing breakout continuations once short-term index digestion settles.
Heightened rate-cut uncertainty increases overhead resistance for rate-sensitive financials and auto names trading inside consolidation patterns.

marketDirection.disclaimer: A rules-based read of index price, market breadth and headline flow — not a forecast or trading advice.

marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices closed a truncated week ending November 13 with marginal weekly gains (Nifty 50 at 25,144.30, up 0.46% for the week), marking a third consecutive week of advances. Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) cash inflows of over ₹5,250 crore on Friday countered domestic institutional profit booking. However, tailwinds were checked by October headline retail inflation spiking to 6.09%—breaching the RBI's 6.0% upper tolerance band—alongside Brent crude advancing toward $95.50/bbl, which led to a 155-point pullback on Friday and tempered breakout momentum across rate-sensitive sectors.
dailyFocus: Track post-earnings consolidation pivots in defence and power equipment counters against macro inflation headwinds; assess volume absorption near swing supports for HAL, BEL, and Trent while monitoring Cochin Shipyard's ex-dividend reaction.

sectors.name: Power Transmission & Electrical Equipment
sectors.reason: Structural multi-year grid expansion and AI/data-centre transformer demand continue to fuel order backlogs and capacity expansions across equipment makers.
catalysts: Sustained order backlog accretion across transformer and switchgear manufacturers
Record export demand and multi-gigawatt grid modernisation capex commitments
risks: Raw material volatility in copper and CRGO electrical steel
Local environmental compliance delays at select operational facilities

sectors.name: Defence & Aerospace
sectors.reason: Topline execution remains elevated across PSU majors with continuous incremental contract flows, though second-quarter margin contraction requires constructive base building.
catalysts: Continuous domestic Ministry of Defence contract awards and fast-tracked procurement cycles
Alleviation of aero-engine supply bottlenecks supporting Tejas delivery roadmaps
risks: Sequential operating margin compression from elevated input costs and project mix
Extended procurement cycles for mega contracts (such as QRSAM)

sectors.name: Capital Goods & Engineering
sectors.reason: Resilient infrastructure execution and robust private capex order books provide solid foundation for multi-week basing patterns.
catalysts: Double-digit revenue growth in industrial and automation segments
Public and private sector infrastructure expenditure acceleration
risks: Elevated working capital cycles in turnkey project execution
Macro headwinds from persistent domestic food inflation

sectors.name: Retail & Consumer Discretionary
sectors.reason: Select franchise leaders demonstrate healthy store additions and margin durability, but broader consumption faces uneven urban demand and inflationary pressure.
catalysts: Festive season footfall acceleration and footprint expansion in Tier-2/3 cities
Operating leverage in high-velocity value-fashion retail formats
risks: CPI inflation breaching 6% impacting discretionary consumer wallets
Higher store rental and operational costs capping EBIT expansion

sectors.name: Banking & Financial Services
sectors.reason: Higher-than-expected October CPI print diminishes the probability of an early RBI repo rate easing cycle, keeping banking indices under technical resistance.
catalysts: Sustained credit growth in commercial and retail credit portfolios
Stable asset quality and historically low gross non-performing asset ratios
risks: Prolonged higher cost of deposits squeezing net interest margins
Postponement of systemic liquidity easing and monetary policy accommodation

news.headline: FIIs Net Infuse ₹5,254 Crore on NSE as Benchmarks Secure Third Weekly Advance
news.summary: Foreign institutional investors registered net cash market purchases of ₹5,253.98 crore on the NSE during Friday's session (November 13), lifting total November institutional inflows past ₹84,000 crore. In contrast, domestic institutional investors turned net sellers of ₹2,253.58 crore, creating a tug-of-war as benchmark Nifty 50 finished at 25,144.30.
news.impact: Institutional cash absorption indicates large-cap base support, favoring swing breakout continuations once short-term index digestion settles.

news.headline: October CPI Inflation Jumps to 6.09%, Breaching RBI's Tolerance Band
news.summary: India's headline retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance ceiling of 6.00% for the first time in two years, led primarily by sticky food prices. Concurrently, Brent crude rallied toward $95.50 per barrel, triggering concerns over deferred rate cuts at the upcoming RBI monetary policy committee meeting.
news.impact: Heightened rate-cut uncertainty increases overhead resistance for rate-sensitive financials and auto names trading inside consolidation patterns.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures Additional ₹619 Crore Defence Orders
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited announced on November 13 that it secured incremental contracts totaling ₹619 crore following its prior release on November 6. The awards encompass communication equipment, unmanned aerial vehicles/drones, electro-optics systems, laser range finders, and spares. This builds onto its substantial order backlog of ₹68,717 crore reported at the end of the second quarter.
news.impact: Steady contract accretion provides fundamental floor for swing traders monitoring base consolidation near its 50-day moving average.

news.headline: Hindustan Aeronautics Posts 16% Rise in Q2 Net Profit; EBITDA Margins Contract
news.summary: HAL reported audited Q2 FY27 results on November 12, with consolidated net profit rising 16% YoY to ₹1,936 crore on a 14.9% increase in revenue to ₹7,613 crore. However, EBITDA margin contracted to 24.1% from 27.1% due to higher input and operational expenses. In parallel, ICRA withdrew credit ratings on ₹6,050 crore of bank facilities following the company's request.
news.impact: Price reaction reflects margin digestion; watch for multi-session volume stabilization around recent swing support of ₹4,800.

news.headline: CG Power Schedules Institutional Investor Conference for November 27 Amid Capex Ramp
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions notified exchanges on November 12 that it will host an institutional investor conference on November 27, 2026. This follows recent board-approved capital expenditures, including a ₹68 crore 10,000 MVA power transformer addition and a ₹748 crore switchgear expansion, while management resolves recent state environmental directives for its Waluj facility.
news.impact: Upcoming institutional interaction offers management a forum to clarify execution schedules and regulatory steps, serving as a scheduled volatility catalyst.

news.headline: Trent Delivers 25% Q2 Profit Expansion; Leadership Transition Formally Completed
news.summary: Tata Group retail major Trent posted a 25.3% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹468 crore for Q2 FY27, with operating revenue advancing 21.9% to ₹5,873 crore and EBITDA margin expanding to 18.2%. The company crossed the 1,000-store mark for Zudio. Noel Tata officially retired as Chairman on November 11, with Bahram Vakil assuming the role of Chairman effective November 12, 2026.
news.impact: Resilient top-line execution reinforces Trent's multi-week cup-and-handle structure, positioning it as an institutional leader in discretionary retail.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Bags ₹498.58 Cr Naval Frigate Refit Deal Amid Q2 Margin Drag
news.summary: The Ministry of Defence inked a ₹498.58 crore contract with Cochin Shipyard on November 11 for the normal refit and propulsion re-powering of INS Betwa. The catalyst coincides with Cochin Shipyard's Q2 results, where net profit fell 50% YoY to ₹54 crore due to a loss in the shipbuilding segment, alongside a declared interim dividend of ₹3 per share (record date November 16, 2026).
news.impact: Ex-dividend adjustment on November 16 alongside mixed shipbuilding operational margins demands strict risk control around range lows.

news.headline: Hitachi Energy India Surges 11% on 86% Jump in Second-Quarter Orders
news.summary: Hitachi Energy India logged an 86% year-on-year surge in second-quarter order inflows, driven by utility-scale renewable transmission integration and high-voltage grid contracts. The stock surged over 11% on November 13, defying broader market consolidation and reinforcing institutional appetite across electrical equipment names.
news.impact: Decisive high-volume gap up provides leadership impetus for sympathy setups within the power transmission and transformer ancillary space.

news.headline: Grasim Industries Posts ₹234 Crore Q2 Net Loss on Margin Pressure
news.summary: Grasim Industries declared Q2 FY27 results on November 13, posting a consolidated net loss of ₹234 crore compared with profit in the prior-year period, despite revenue expanding to ₹50,105 crore. Profitability was impacted by elevated introductory investments in its paints division and soft realization in chemical segments.
news.impact: Earnings miss creates immediate overhead supply, invalidating near-term base breakout attempts until quarterly margin stabilization occurs.

news.headline: Vodafone Idea Q2 Net Loss Widens to ₹5,975 Crore Despite ARPU Gain
news.summary: Vodafone Idea announced Q2 FY27 results on November 12, reporting a consolidated net loss of ₹5,975 crore, compared to ₹5,524 crore in the year-ago period, impacted by treasury mark-to-market adjustments. Revenue rose 6.2% YoY to ₹11,884 crore, aided by 4G/5G subscriber upgrades that pushed ARPU to ₹198.
news.impact: Widening bottom-line deficits keep the counter confined to a high-beta range, lacking technical structural momentum required for swing setups.
